entry_route.value: Applicants may hold a bachelor's in engineering or science, and the PhD also counts coursework from a master's entry.
entry_route.quote: the bachelor's degree held by applicants to the program may be in engineering, biological, physical, or mathematical sciences

also.quote: a minimum of 38 semester hours of graduate coursework is expected for students entering with an appropriate master's degree

gre_general.value: Needed for unconditional admission: combined score above 308 with verbal at least 146. Probationary admission is possible if only one of the GPA or GRE criteria is missed.
gre_general.quote: GRE Total (quantitative plus verbal) must be greater than 308 with a verbal score of 146 or better.

also.quote: If an applicant meets the criteria for either the GPA or the GRE, but does not meet the minimum criteria for the other, a probationary admission can be granted.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: The page names a track advisor for coursework, not a supervisor who must agree before admission.

funding.value: The page gives no funding rule for admitted students.

deadline.value: The page gives no application deadline.

notes: Catalog page only. The department asks for a TOEFL iBT of 79 or better, the same as the university minimum.
name: Biomedical Engineering PhD
